The [[Orion system/Legends|Orion system]] contained the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Orion]] and the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Star system/Legends|system]], [[Orion IV]], was inhabited. It was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. [[Operation Strike Fear]] took place in this [[Sector/Legends|sector]].
